_comment: This file is parsed as strict JSON by editorconfig-checker 6.x, so the reasoning lives in a key named _comment rather than in // comments. A // line here is a parse error, not a comment: verified, it makes the step exit 2 before checking anything.

IndentSize is disabled because it is incompatible with the output of this project's own formatter. Prettier uses alignment as well as indentation, and an aligned continuation line is not a multiple of the indent size by definition: prettier indents a wrapped call's arguments to sit under the opening parenthesis. Measured: with this check on, the tree reports errors and every one of them is formatter output, not a mistake.
What remains is still worth running: end-of-line, final newline and trailing whitespace on .gitignore, .gitattributes, .nvmrc and the SQL files, which prettier cannot parse at all.
